summary: Microbot Medical Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a Letter of Agreement with Sanmina Corporation to manufacture its LIBERTY Endovascular Robotic System. No financial terms, stake percentage, price, premium, or board recommendation were provided. The agreement is aimed at expanding manufacturing capacity and supporting cost reduction. This is a routine manufacturing supply arrangement, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing includes no deal mechanics, advisors, or regulatory clock. What to watch: future revenue impact and production ramp.
